spans.s: (Ved. for 2. क; only gen. sg. with चिद्), every one (e.g. नि॑ षू॑ नमा॑तिमतिं क॑यस्य चित्, bow well down the haughtiness of every one, RV. i, 129, 5), RV. i, 27, 8; viii, 25, 15;
(inst. fem. of 2. क) in what manner? RV.
